findings.text: §14's done-when case 2 requires "a bare-string finding and a `detail`/`title` finding" to be held "as blocking, as today", but `repair.review_findings` (repair.py:103-125) skips any finding that is not a bare `Mapping` before classification, so a bare-string finding is silently discarded today, never blocking — a node writing that case would find it contradicts the reader it runs against

findings.reason: the mechanism as written does not produce the behaviour the section and its done-when assert, so the node would implement dead branches or restructure a reader the plan does not mention.
findings.text: §14 says "Repair's finding readers skip a finding that states none" and that a rule keyed on `text` alone would wrongly drop 24 real findings "written as bare strings or under `detail` and `title`", but those readers consume pre-normalised entries from `review_findings`, which reads only `finding.get("text")` and drops non-mappings — so a `detail`-only mapping reaches `_finding_kind` with empty text and no severity (blocking by severity-absence, not by the predicate), and a bare string never reaches it at all; the predicate as specified has no reachable consumer for two of its four claim fields

findings.reason: the dispatch gate names the wrong releasing node, so it reads as a hold condition that does not exist and can delay or mis-scope §14's dispatch.
findings.text: followup `f-erkc-014` says "dispatch once §13's integration has released `review.py`", but §13's landed commits (6e00dd22f, db761b538) change only `promotion.py`, tests and evidence; `review.py`'s last writers are §12 (a9e9d3226, 2cf84885c) and §9(b) (4133b3e75), both landed, so review.py is already free and §13 releases nothing

findings.reason: the 24-finding figure is the sole justification for the string/`summary`/`detail`/`title` branches, and a node unable to re-derive it may correctly narrow the rule the section intends to be broad.
findings.text: §14's "Why" rests on a census ("covers 6,927 records with findings", "7 findings in 3 files state none", "24 real findings" that a `text`-only rule would drop) with no cited script, directory, log or commit, so the figure that justifies the predicate's breadth cannot be re-derived
